authorization.request: 用户要求未声明适配 Desktop 的插件仍可安装，并由 DSH Desktop 官方插件管理器按自身规则校验，而不是由商城兼容性声明拦截。

objective: 让受商城管理的已审核第三方插件在不声明 Desktop 适配或精确兼容记录时，仍可提交给 DSH Desktop 官方 pluginManager 安装；Catalog 适配与兼容声明只作信息展示，安装校验和拒绝原因由官方管理器负责。

change.installation: 不再用 Catalog profiles/dshReleases 或商城推导的 runtimeVersion 阻止已审核第三方插件安装；仍要求规范 GitHub 仓库、固定 Commit、包身份确认和显式用户确认，并保护商城自身及 @deepseek-ai/* 官方组件。
change.officialValidation: 先调用官方 pluginManager.inspect；inspect 拒绝时显示官方原因；通过后只调用 pluginManager.installBundle，由其检查实际 Git 包的 DSH engines/peers 等规则，并展示结构化拒绝原因。
change.lifecycle: 启动/关闭不再使用 Catalog compatibility gate；现有 DSH 管理器状态、Bundle 来源、官方/自身组件保护和可卸载状态约束继续生效。

gates: Bind all changes to the current base Commit and exact file hashes; reject out-of-scope edits.
Disposable tests prove an unadapted, unknown, incompatible, and missing-runtime-version Catalog entry can reach official Desktop confirmation and pluginManager inspection.
Disposable tests prove official inspect refusal and installBundle DSH-compatibility refusal are shown to the user without resubmitting.
No third-party package code is executed by this workflow; the real Desktop Profile remains a separate explicitly confirmed operation.
Publish source through a CI-checked PR and update the Catalog with a fresh post-merge fixed-Commit plan.

rollback.source: Revert only this source change through a CI-checked PR.
rollback.desktopProfile: This source change does not mutate the real Desktop Profile; any installed package rollback uses only the DSH official Desktop plugin manager under its own plan.

healthCheck: A disposable Desktop Client tree exposes enabled Install for approved fixed-Commit Catalog entries regardless of adaptation/compatibility declarations; official manager rejection is visible and no install call occurs after a refused inspect.
